main_text.p: Est præceps & cæca, leuis, ridenda: leuésque, Præcipites, cæcos, ridiculósque facit.
Hoc ætas veterum vidit persæpe diúque: O vtinam nunc non nostra videret idem!
main_text.head: E seruo Rex, è Rege seruus.
main_text.p: Furcifer antè fuit, qui nunc est sceptrifer: & qui Furcifer est nunc, is sceptrifer ante fuit.
Id fortis cæco natum ne credito fluxu, Quod fecit fortis prouida cura Dei: Qui laqueo torquem, laqueum qui torque repente Mutat, vt Irus sit qui modo Croesus erat.
main_text.head: Nubes in aëre multi formes.
Spes Inanes.
main_text.p: Sufpice per latum suspensas aëra nubes, Et nubi quæ sit cuique figura, vide.
Ista leoninos ridus, vrsosque, luposque: Et pardos, iunctis tygribus, illa refert.
Semiboues, & semiuiros: cum ciuibus vrbes Hæc gerit: illa parit prælia, castra duces.
Hæc simulachra modis oculos fallentia miris Esse videntur, re sunt tamen apse nihil.
Omnibus his hominum spes æquiparantur inanes, Nil pariunt, etsi plurima parturiant.
main_text.head: Assecla mensarum.
main_text.p: Qui tibi blanditur canis & comitatur euntem, Rure, domíque, tuas & cubat ante fores.
Falleris esse tui, forsan si reris amantem, Non te, sed mensam captat amáţque tuam.

page.notes: Woodcut-style decorative emblem figures and stray marks appear between the poems; the manuscript word "Parasitus" in the left margin is handwriting and was not transcribed. Several lines are faint or partly obscured by show-through; "fortis" and "Nubes" lines were read with some uncertainty, and the line "Ista leoninos" is read as printed "ridus" which may be "ridus". Marked [?] where doubtful is not applied to whole lines given legibility.
